findings.source_passage: prick your ears in this self-same ship
findings.source_locator: paragraph beginning 'But a day or two after'
findings.why_it_matters: The phrase 'prick your ears' is a small but characteristically precise Melvillean sensory detail that the draft omits, reducing the vividness of the contrast passage.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'and prick your ears in this self-same ship' after 'you look about you.'

findings.source_passage: the reason why the decks never look so white as just after what they call an affair of oil
findings.source_locator: paragraph beginning 'But a day or two after', mid-section
findings.why_it_matters: The wry phrase 'what they call an affair of oil' is a register-defining bit of sailors' euphemism that Melville savors; its omission flattens the ironic documentary voice.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the sentence: 'This is the reason why the decks never look so white as just after what they call an affair of oil.'

findings.source_passage: the soot is brushed from the lower rigging. All the numerous implements which have been in use are likewise faithfully cleansed and put away.
findings.source_locator: paragraph beginning 'But a day or two after', mid-section inventory of cleaning
findings.why_it_matters: The meticulous inventory of cleaning tasks is a deliberate rhetorical accumulation whose rhythm enacts the exhausting thoroughness; compressing it loses that performative effect.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore at minimum the rigging and implements sentences to preserve the cumulative rhythm of the cleaning catalogue.

findings.source_passage: think of having hanging to the top
findings.why_it_matters: This whimsical detail (suggesting curtains hung from the mast-top) is a characteristically absurdist flourish; its quiet omission slightly deflates the comic register of the passage.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'think of having hanging to the top' within the list of sailors' domestic fantasies.

summary: No high- or medium-severity signature losses; the draft preserves all major signature passages (the opening anaphora, the 'bridegrooms new-leaped from out the daintiest Holland' climax, the 'man-killing / Yet this is life' meditation, and the Pythagoras coda) with only minor omissions of small but flavourful Melvillean details in the cleaning inventory and the sailors' fantasy paragraph.
